name: IOVANCE BIOTHERAPEUTICS INC

priced.reason: not a repriceable fcff name or no growth supplied

devils_advocate.strongest_counter: That 'no_model' is doing no work here, and that the brief hands me a comparables answer — a blended $3.18 against a $7.74 price, a 58.9% overvaluation — which I am declining to use because it is inconvenient. Three separate rows (ev_sales, ev_gross_profit, p_tbv) all point the same way, which looks like corroboration; on that reading the honest verdict is 'rich' and the refusal is evasion.
devils_advocate.what_would_prove_it: Whether the cohort and the denominator the multiples divide are meaningful for this company today.
devils_advocate.already_visible: Yes, and it defeats the counter on both arms. The cohort is explicitly unranked — the brief itself says there are too few comparable Health Care names to define a distribution honestly — which is the first arm of the RIOT/EPRT refusal test. And the three rows are NOT independent: they share a trailing denominator describing a company roughly 40% smaller than the one trading today, with revenue growing 80% year over year and guidance of $410-420M against an LTM of $263.5M. That is the MXL condition exactly, where agreement among rows is one error appearing three times rather than three errors cancelling. On the Q3 run rate ev_sales falls from 12.2x toward about 7x, which moves the blend substantially. The counter is right that refusing is not the same as being neutral, which is why I have said plainly above what the name costs on forward sales rather than leaving the impression it is cheap.
devils_advocate.unresolved: Everything that decides this company: whether the biomarker-selected lung response rate replicates prospectively, what fraction of NSCLC patients the biomarker selects, and what Amtagvi's steady-state melanoma revenue is. None of it is a valuation question and none of it is answerable from free sources. I also did not verify the 'well into 2029' runway against the quarterly burn myself; on $57.9M of cash plus $318.4M of short-term investments against roughly $300M a year of operating outflow, that claim appears to require the revenue ramp to continue, not merely the current balance sheet.

what_changed: The lung readout arrived and it is the reason for the 40% drawdown. The 2026-11-05 release reports a 24.6% ORR in 69 patients with non-squamous mNSCLC from cohorts 1 and 2 of IOV-LUN-202, with 59.1% in the biomarker-selected subgroup, and 55.6% confirmed ORR in nine patients with undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma and dedifferentiated liposarcoma, for which lifileucel won Fast Track designation. Commercially the quarter was strong: revenue about $122M, up ~80%, US Amtagvi up ~77%, gross margin to ~60%, 2026 guidance of $410-420M reaffirmed, cash runway stated into 2029, and new POSITILITY and OPTILISM trials added on the strength of the biomarker-selected data. None of it changes the valuation question: the company remains cash-flow negative in every year of the window, with operating cash flow of -$302.4M, -$353.0M and -$361.8M.
consensus_case: The market pays $3.58bn for a commercial-stage cell-therapy company with a launched product, no debt and no profits. Amtagvi (lifileucel) passed $100M of US revenue in a single quarter for the first time; total Q3 revenue was about $122M, up roughly 80% year on year; gross margin reached a record ~60% from 56% in Q2; full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $410-420M was reaffirmed; and management says current cash funds operations well into 2029. On about $415M of 2026 revenue the equity is on roughly 8.6x sales for an autologous TIL platform with label-expansion readouts in lung cancer and sarcoma. The price is a bet on the platform rather than on melanoma, and that is why the stock is up roughly 325% over twelve months and down 40% over the last twenty-one days: on 2026-11-05 the company reported a 24.6% objective response rate in 69 patients with non-squamous metastatic NSCLC — durable, but modest on an unselected population — against 59.1% in the biomarker-selected subgroup. The market marked down the breadth of the lung opportunity while keeping the selected-population case.
base_case_rationale: No valuation is supplied, and no fair value should be, because this name has no modellable cash-flow base and the comparables table on the brief is unusable. The engine itself refused: `status` is model_failed, the normalized FCFF base is 'n/a' computed over ZERO years, and no enterprise value was calculated at all. Operating cash flow is negative in all three years and accelerating away from zero; EBIT is -$403.4M; `nonpositive_normalized_fcff` and `negative_ebitda_valued_on_revenue_or_gross_profit_only` both fire. That is the correct and complete answer: a discounted cash flow cannot value negative cash flow, and roughly 40% of this universe — financials, REITs and cash-burning biotech — cannot be honestly valued by a free FCFF model. What I will not do is substitute the multiples blend of $3.18, because it fails the standing refusal test on two independent arms. The cohort is NOT RANKED — the brief says so in terms, 'too few comparable Health Care names to define a distribution honestly' — and the trailing denominator no longer describes the business: `revenue_ltm` is $263.5M against full-year guidance of $410-420M and a Q3 run rate near $488M annualised, so the 12.2x ev_sales the table reports is a measurement artifact in the same way MaxLinear's was on 2026-09-10. On the Q3 run rate the same ratio is nearer 7x. Refusing is not a judgement that the name is cheap, and the honest statement is that at roughly 8.6x 2026 guided sales, pre-profit, with the breadth of the lung opportunity just narrowed to a biomarker-selected subgroup, I can see no basis on which to call it either way.
key_risks: Operating cash flow is negative in all three years of the window and accelerating away from zero: -$302.4M, -$353.0M, -$361.8M, with EBIT of -$403.4M
The 21-day 40% drawdown is the unselected lung ORR of 24.6% in 69 patients; the 59.1% figure applies to a biomarker-selected subgroup whose size is not disclosed
The multiples blend of $3.18 must be DISREGARDED, not read as -58.9%: the cohort is unranked and all three rows divide a trailing revenue roughly 40% below the current run rate

The stated cash runway into 2029 rests on $57.9M of cash plus $318.4M of short-term investments against roughly $300M a year of outflow, so it requires the revenue ramp to continue rather than just the existing balance sheet
462.7M shares outstanding on a company that has funded itself through the equity market repeatedly
watch_for: The biomarker-selected lung response rate replicating prospectively in POSITILITY and OPTILISM, and disclosure of what fraction of patients the biomarker selects
Gross margin progression past ~60% as the manufacturing network scales
Quarterly operating cash burn against the 'well into 2029' runway, and any return to the equity market
2027 revenue guidance — whether the ramp continues off $410-420M or plateaus near the melanoma opportunity
